name: Clairfoyer

approval.instruction: Integrate buildings and workstations; retain right angles with unequal blocks, squares, rectangles and offset junctions.

provenance.tool: Watabou Medieval Fantasy City Generator — public source edition
provenance.adaptation: Only explicit plaza/citadel/walls constructor flags; headless Point/Rectangle compatibility. Two Haxe 4 typing fixes (explicit last element and Float array); generation algorithm unchanged.

roadGeometry.distanceDecision: Internal junctions and parcels reorganized; original distances remain references, not a claim of unchanged physical lengths.

circulation.orientationPolicy: housing portals face nearest street; civic portals face courtyard; four native views without image rotation

defence.reason: No enclosing wall or citadel established by the bible; optional access watch subject to review.

outposts.mission: observe the only existing land approach

requirements: confirm fresh water and treatment before activation
reserve public well/cistern sites; no claim of aquifer or stocks

logistics.food: grain and honey hinterland of Boisclair; supplier options from bible remain uncontracted

performance.simulation: existing persistent actors; no NPC per design resident
performance.renderer: reuse native model caches and spatial query; no whole-city texture

designNote: Unequal orthogonal blocks with squares, long and short rectangles, offset T junctions and a stepped outer footprint; all entrances connected.
